newsitem.title: USA: Total-Tel signed pact with Unisource.
newsitem.headline: Total-Tel signed pact with Unisource.

text.p: TotalTel International Inc, a subsidiary of TotalTel USA Communications Inc, said Wednesday it signed an access supply agreement with Unisource Carrier Services AG, an independent pan-European network operator.

According to the agreement, effective on July 15, TotalTel can originate and terminate traffic on UCS's pan-European backbone network, allowing it to expand its retail and wholesale services across Europe.
The UCS network will allow TotalTel to provide international voice and data services in 25 cities in 15 European countries and ATM services in six cities.
The company said it will open 23 sales offices in Europe by the end of 1998.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
